ContractScribe campaign

Usage:
  contract-scribe campaign start --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --campaign-lineage <id> [--configuration <path>] [--configuration-override <path>]
  contract-scribe campaign resume --repository-root <path> --input <path> --policy <path> --snapshot <binding> --state <path> --campaign-lineage <id> [--configuration <path>] [--configuration-override <path>]

Options:
  --repository-root <path>         Existing repository root.
  --input <path>                   Existing .sln, .slnx, or .csproj inside the repository.
  --policy <path>                  Existing M1 policy file inside the repository.
  --snapshot <binding>             Caller-attested immutable snapshot binding.
  --state <path>                   Campaign checkpoint outside the repository.
  --campaign-lineage <id>          Caller-attested durable campaign lineage identity.
  --configuration <path>           Optional non-secret consumer configuration layer.
  --configuration-override <path>  Optional invocation configuration layer; wins over --configuration.
  -h, --help                       Print this help.

Environment:
  CONTRACTSCRIBE_PROVIDER_API_KEY  Selected transport credential; never persisted or emitted.

Exit codes:
  0  Campaign complete or no work.
  2  Invalid command-line usage.
  3  Bounded resumable stop.
  4  Invalid configuration, state, lease, revision, or snapshot.
  5  Terminal execution or checkpoint-publication failure.
  6  Cancelled.
  7  Timeout.
